sleeping_bag.name: LITE LINE 300
sleeping_bag.subtitle: ultralight 2-3 season down sleeping bag
sleeping_bag.description: Lite Line 300 is presented as the midweight option in the ultralight Lite Line 2-2.5 season range, intended for spring-summer mountain trips, forest bivy overnights, and fast-and-light bikepacking adventures.
sleeping_bag.key_features:
- 600 g total weight
- 300 g of 850 FP ethically sourced Polish goose down
- Comfort 4 C / limit 0 C / extreme -15 C
- Pertex Quantum 29 g/m2 shell and liner
- 15D ripstop, DWR finish, 100% nylon
- Full-length 5 mm YKK zip with 2 self-locking sliders
- Anti-snag system and zipper garage
- Down-filled zip insulating tube
- 3D shaped hood
- Anatomical shark-fin footbox
- Trapezoid chamber design
- Separately filled front and bottom
- Differential cut
- Inner zipped mesh pocket with noctilucent puller
- Stuffsack and storage sack included
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Cumulus presents Lite Line 300 as the right target for lightweight spring-summer use, balancing minimal weight with reliable warmth and compactness.
sleeping_bag.ideal_for: Spring-summer mountain trips, forest bivy overnights, fast-and-light bikepacking.
sleeping_bag.comparison_notes: France category price observed from user-provided capture is 325 EUR.
sleeping_bag.warranty_notes: Lifetime Experience warranty shown on official pages.
